renew_timer.description: Time (seconds) after which client should attempt to renew lease.

rebind_timer.description: Time (seconds) after which client should attempt to rebind lease if renewal fails.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum lease time (seconds) the server will assign; overrides client requests above this.

lease_changes_interval.description: Interval (ms) between checks for lease updates; set to 0 for no periodic checks.

valid_lifetime.description: Default time (seconds) that a lease is considered valid.

authoritative.description: If true, server responds with DHCPNAK to requests for invalid or unknown subnets.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) per log file before rotation (0 = no rotation).

log_max_ver.description: Maximum number of archived log files to keep (0 = no archiving).

log_severity.description: Minimum severity level for logged messages.

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0 = no debug messages, up to 99).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces the server will listen on.

dhcp_socket_type.description: Socket type for DHCP communication. Use 'raw' for direct Ethernet access.

control_socket_name.description: Unix socket path for Kea control API.

gateway.description: Gateway IP address for clients in this subnet.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS server addresses for clients.

domain_name.description: DNS domain name for clients (DHCP option 15).

pools.description: List of dynamic IP address pools for this subnet.

value.description: Value of the option (string or numeric).

option_data.description: Custom DHCP options to include in responses.

subnets.description: List of IPv4 subnets to serve.
